name: supermedia-skills
scope: Shared Supermedia engineering skills intended to be reused by Codex, Claude, and developers across software projects.

governance.documentation_language: Chinese governance documents and SKILL.md bodies with English-first skill metadata.
governance.metadata_policy: SKILL.md frontmatter name and description should be English-first for cross-agent discovery; SKILL.md bodies should use Chinese except for necessary technical terms, tool names, code, commands, and field names.
governance.scope_policy: common is for framework-agnostic shared engineering workflows; framework-specific shared skills should use a technology scope such as laravel.

consumer_policy.pinning: Projects should pin this repository by git tag or commit SHA before loading shared skills.
consumer_policy.project_specific_rules: Domain rules belong in the consuming project, not in this shared repository.
consumer_policy.local_override_policy: Consuming projects should not edit shared skills locally. Project-specific instructions should live beside the consuming project and reference the pinned shared skills source.
consumer_policy.conflict_resolution: Project runtime constraints can override shared guidance for that project, but shared skill behavior should be changed in this repository rather than forked silently.
consumer_policy.upgrade_review: Shared skill upgrades should be reviewed against at least one real project before broad rollout.

definitions.draft: May change quickly while trigger quality, workflow shape, and compatibility are still being proven.
definitions.stable: Reviewed for shared use and should only change through intentional behavior review.
definitions.deprecated: Retained for compatibility but should not be newly adopted.

release_policy.recommended_pinning: Consuming projects should pin a git tag or commit SHA.
release_policy.stable_release_gate: Stable releases require validation, changelog coverage, and review against at least one real consuming project without copying project-specific rules back into shared skills.

checks: CHANGELOG contains the current VERSION heading
manifest scope matches skill path scope
SKILL.md frontmatter contains name and description
all discovered skills are listed in the manifest

skills.name: project-truth-source
skills.description: Use when a task depends on project specs, implementation behavior, tests, or docs that may disagree across files or sources.

skills.name: ai-change-review-guardrails
skills.description: Use before accepting AI-generated or large backend/API/scheduler/security changes, especially when hidden assumptions or blast radius matter.

skills.name: test-review-sop
skills.description: Use when adding, updating, reviewing, or deleting tests, especially for policy, state machine, API contract, auth, regression, or high-risk boundary coverage.

skills.name: git-commit-workflow
skills.description: Use when staging, splitting, reviewing, or creating commits in a dirty worktree, especially to avoid mixing unrelated changes or committing generated or local-only noise.

skills.name: skill-maintenance-governance
skills.description: Use when creating, updating, compressing, removing, or syncing shared or project skills, especially to prevent duplicated agent instructions, drift, or project-specific rules leaking into shared skills.

skills.name: tenant-access-boundaries
skills.description: Use when implementing or reviewing tenant, organization, team, account, workspace, or project-scoped access boundaries in backend services, APIs, jobs, or data queries.

skills.name: scheduler-side-effect-guardrails
skills.description: Use when creating, changing, or reviewing scheduled jobs, cron tasks, queues, expiration handlers, lifecycle transitions, notifications, or retryable batch operations.

skills.name: laravel-migration-safety
skills.description: Use when creating, changing, renaming, reviewing, or backfilling Laravel database migrations, especially when deployment status is unknown.

skills.name: laravel-api-contract
skills.description: Use when adding or changing Laravel API endpoints, Form Requests, Resources, response wrappers, OpenAPI/Scramble docs, or client-facing response shapes.

skills.name: laravel-auth-authorization-flow
skills.description: Use when implementing or reviewing Laravel authentication and authorization flows, including Sanctum tokens, token abilities, middleware ordering, role or profile loading, login boundaries, and audit logging.

skills.name: laravel-route-authorization-matrix
skills.description: Use when adding, changing, or reviewing Laravel API routes, route groups, middleware chains, role access, throttle policies, or public versus protected endpoint boundaries.

skills.name: laravel-scramble-api-docs
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing Laravel Scramble API documentation, especially Resource or Form Request schemas, nested responses, required fields, nullability, response wrappers, or schema export verification.

skills.name: laravel-security-testing
skills.description: Use when planning or reviewing Laravel API security test coverage, including auth boundaries, route permission matrices, tenant isolation, token behavior, rate limits, sensitive data exposure, and OWASP baseline checks.
